question: Which is the first private company to launch a rocket into space in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skyroot Aerospace**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Skyroot Aerospace** is the correct answer as it became the first private company in **India** to successfully launch a rocket into space. This historic event took place on **November 18, 2022**.
 
• The mission was named **Prarambh** (meaning 'the beginning'), signifying a new era for the private space sector in the country. The rocket used for this mission was the **Vikram-S**, a single-stage solid-fuel sub-orbital launch vehicle.
 
• The launch was conducted from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC)** in **Sriharikota**, **Andhra Pradesh**, which is the primary spaceport of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• The **Vikram-S** rocket reached a peak altitude of approximately **89.5 kilometers**, successfully crossing the altitude required for its sub-orbital flight profile and carrying three customer payloads, including one from **Space Kidz India**.
